title: [Dickly] Bifold Door Hardware Kit, Sliding Door Hardware, Heavy Duty Door Installation
description:
[Dickly] Bifold Door Hardware Kit, Sliding Door Hardware, Heavy Duty Door Installation
Description:
【Product Type】: Bifold door hardware set, great for door installation and repair.
【Durable Material】: The door repair set is made of stainless steel material, high hardness, sturdy and durable to use.
【Easy Installation】: Sliding closet door hardware replacement parts, easy to install, save time and money.

【Wide Applications】: The door hardware set is suitable for folding pocket doors, accordion doors, barn doors, sliding doors, folding doors, wardrobe doors, cabinet doors, etc.
Specification:
Packaging size: 15cmx15cm/5.91inchx5.91inch
Material: Stainless steel
Package Includes:
1 Bifold Door Hardware Set
Note:
